name: Wooden Hypostyle Mosques of Medieval Anatolia
description: Five mosques scattered across Türkiye, in Afyon, Ankara, Konya, Kastamonu and Eskişehir provinces, were built between the late 13th and mid-14th centuries. Plain masonry walls hide a forest of timber columns inside, holding up a flat wooden ceiling. Visitors come for the intricate woodcarving on the columns, doors, pulpits and other fittings, which gives these Seljuk-era prayer halls a warm, intimate feel.
